citations.title: Nanonets Overview
excerpts: Nanonets is a platform for turning complex business processes into agents. You build with two primitives: agents and context graphs. Agents do the work. An agent reads incoming documents, applies your business rules, decides what to do, escalates when it is uncertain, and writes structured results into your systems of record. Agents run multi-step workflows without a human in the loop. Context graphs hold the rules agents work from. A context graph stores your business rules as a machine-readable structure where every constraint is a node and every dependency is an edge. ... Data extraction is powered by Nanonets OCR-3, ranked #1 on the IDP Leaderboard, and the workflow is driven by Nanonets agents and context graphs. Every agent decision is traceable to the document it read and the rule it applied. Low-confidence results route to a human reviewer, and corrections update the rule for every agent that shares it.

basis.reasoning: The public product documentation explicitly says data extraction is powered by Nanonets OCR-3.
